bonuses.name: Dimensional Destabilisation
bonuses.text: Canoptek Wraiths can move through solid objects, treating them as Difficult Terrain.

bonuses.name: Living Metal
bonuses.text: At the start of each of this Threat’s turns it regains 1 Wound and 1 Shock.

abilities.name: Lurking Horrors
abilities.text: Canoptek Wraiths can enter combat by emerging from a solid object. All opponents of the Hexmark Destroyer must make a DN 2 Initiative Test or are Ambushed. Additionally, all opponents of the Hexmark Destroyer must make a DN 2 Fear Test.

mobAbilities.name: Fearful Host
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of Canoptek Wraiths that uses Lurking Horrors adds +2 to both the Initiative and Fear Test.
